## Introduction to kawata.py

**kawata.py** is a specialized fork of the widely-used osu! server implementation, [bancho.py](https://github.com/osuAkatsuki/bancho.py). It is primarily designed for use with modified clients, including those often associated with cheat servers.

Building upon the foundation of **bancho.py**, an ongoing osu! server implementation, kawata.py extends its capabilities to provide a robust platform for developers across all experience levels interested in hosting private osu! server instances.

## Our Mission

Developed by the [Kawata](https://kawata.pw/) team, our objective is to deliver an osu! server implementation that is highly maintainable, reliable, and feature-rich. While optimized for modified client environments, its comprehensive design ensures it remains a powerful and versatile choice for any private osu! server.

## Getting Started

Detailed guides and setup instructions are available in the sidebar. Please refer to these resources to begin configuring your kawata.py server.
